text: On March 26, 2024, the owner of 86 Lombard Street appealed Council's failure to make a decision within the legislated timelines for Zoning By-law Amendment applications for 86, 100-108 Lombard Street and 103 Richmond Street East to the Ontario Land Tribunal. The amendments to the Zoning By-law proposed a 59-storey (216 metres, including mechanical penthouse) mixed-use building containing 480 dwelling units, 4,321 square metres of office space, and 616 square metres of retail space. The former City Morgue building at 86 Lombard Street is designated under Part IV of the Ontario Heritage Act and proposed to be relocated to the eastern portion of the site. A mid-block connection between Richmond Street East and Lombard Street and a public open space are proposed.
